# Online Experiments and A/B Testing

> Run trustworthy online experiments, including tests of AI features, and defend a launch, iterate or stop decision with the right interval. SDAIA Academy course DS-302, version 2027.2.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-302/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-302/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-302/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 18,155 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-302/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Trustworthy experiments](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-302/slides/day1.md): Before any interval: who was assigned, who was exposed, and whether the split can be trusted; sessions: Assignment, exposure and triggering, Sample ratio mismatch and A/A tests, Metrics for AI features, Power for heavy-tailed metrics; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-302/slides/day1.html; about 4,693 tokens
- [Day 2: Precision](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-302/slides/day2.md): The same test, a narrower interval: capping, pre-period data, ratio metrics and strata; sessions: Variance and heavy tails, Regression adjustment, Ratio metrics, Stratification; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-302/slides/day2.html; about 3,831 tokens
- [Day 3: Monitoring and interference](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-302/slides/day3.md): Watch a test every day without inventing wins, and test a marketplace where customers share couriers; sessions: Group sequential designs, Always-valid tests, Interference in marketplaces, Cluster and switchback designs; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-302/slides/day3.html; about 3,914 tokens
- [Day 4: Decide and review](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-302/slides/day4.md): From numbers to a decision: AI-feature tests, many segments, the recommendation and the review board; sessions: Testing AI features, Many segments, Writing the recommendation, The review board; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-302/slides/day4.html; about 4,115 tokens
- [Capstone: The capstone review board](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-302/slides/capstone.md): Each participant defends a design and analysis pack in ten minutes: seven to present, three for the board; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-302/slides/capstone.html; about 1,103 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: Triggered and diluted effects in SQL](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-302/labs/D1_1_triggered_exposure.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: Sample ratio and A/A checks](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-302/labs/D1_2_srm_aa_checks.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: A metric spec for AI-ranked search](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-302/labs/D1_3_ai_search_metrics.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: Power by simulation for the search test](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-302/labs/D1_4_power_heavy_tails.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: Capping order value](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-302/labs/D2_1_capping.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: Regression adjustment with 28 pre-period days](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-302/labs/D2_2_cuped.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: Orders per session: delta method and bootstrap](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-302/labs/D2_3_delta_method.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: City strata in the search test](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-302/labs/D2_4_stratification.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: Group sequential boundaries](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-302/labs/D3_1_group_sequential.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: An always-valid test on the same simulator](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-302/labs/D3_2_always_valid.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: The bias of a customer-randomised dispatch test](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-302/labs/D3_3_courier_interference.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: A city-by-hour switchback and its power](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-302/labs/D3_4_switchback_power.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 4.1: The Luqma chat-assistant test](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-302/labs/D4_1_chat_assistant_test.ipynb): Day 4, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 4.2: Twenty segment results, corrected](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-302/labs/D4_2_segment_fdr.ipynb): Day 4, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 4.3: A one-page recommendation for T-101](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-302/labs/D4_3_launch_recommendation.ipynb): Day 4, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 4.4: Two write-ups, and the capstone change](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-302/labs/D4_4_review_board.ipynb): Day 4, Session 4, 25 min
